notes:
Top-line: Sentrywood is evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) as the preferred inference runtime for customer-facing recommendation and support assistants. They emphasized strict EU data residency (must remain in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1), mandatory audit logging forwarded to their SIEM, and KMS keys controlled in their AWS account (HSM-backed).

Security review status:
- NDA signed 2026-02-16.
- Completed initial security questionnaire (submitted 2026-02-25).
- Requested SOC2 + penetration test scope; Redwood provided SOC2 report and controls mapping (drive link).
- Awaiting pen-test scoping meeting (blocked by KMS pattern decision).

Architecture fit notes (from 2026-03-01 architecture call):
- Preferred topology: private subnets for inference nodes, customer-managed NAT gateways for controlled outbound egress, and VPC endpoints for control-plane comms. They want Transit Gateway attachment into their hub VPC rather than peering.
- Inbound: no public inbound allowed; control-plane -> private control channel authenticated via mutual TLS and customer IP allowlist.
- Outbound: minimal egress only to Redwood control-plane endpoints and model artifact stores; must support proxy for outbound inspection.
- KMS: customer to provide CMKs in their AWS account; Redwood to integrate via cross-account IAM role and external key policy. HSM requirement for root-level keys.
- Audit logs: must forward runtime logs (inference events, model version changes, rollout events) to their S3 logging bucket with SSE-KMS and 7-year retention; also stream to Splunk/Datadog via Kinesis Firehose.
- Regions: initial POC in eu-west-1, later expansion to eu-central-1. No multi-region replication without explicit data residency controls.

POC scope and acceptance criteria:
- 3-week POC: deploy private control plane into customer VPC via Transit Gateway, provision two dedicated GPU nodes, run chat + reranking workload (avg p95 latency < 250ms for small prompt, 5000 tokens/day baseline).
- Verify KMS-based envelope encryption for cached KV and model artifacts.
- Audit log delivery tested end-to-end to their S3 and Splunk.
- Security sign-off: infra security sign-off + penetration test initiation.

Quotes / paraphrase from CTO: "We cannot accept any control-plane telemetry leaving EU boundaries without explicit consent — logs must be ship-to-customer-first."

Commercial / procurement notes:
- Interested in a reserved capacity contract after successful POC. Budget band estimated 250k-750k ARR. Legal needs updated IP and data residency clauses.

Immediate open actions:
- Aaron to deliver network diagram (low-level) by 2026-03-12.
- Redwood infra to produce KMS integration playbook and cross-account role template.
- Schedule pen-test scoping with security team (tentatively 2026-03-18).
- Elena to prepare CSM transition checklist and runbook for handover if POC moves to reserved capacity.
